patthana23.42:1.1: dhammo anidassana appaṭighassa upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo. ārammaṇe cha.
patthana23.42:2.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana23.42:3.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na saṃkiliṭṭhasaṃkilesikaṃ
